name: Layering system
summary: A set of thin layers, each with one task. A base next to the skin, a warm mid layer and a shell against wind and rain. The wearer adds or sheds a layer to fit the work.
how: Put a base layer next to the skin that moves sweat away.
Add a mid layer of wool or fleece to hold warm air.
Close the outfit with a shell that stops wind and rain, and open it when the work warms the body.

origin.note: The Everest party wears silk, wool and a gabardine smock in layers, and the climber adds or sheds one at each rest.

adoptions.via: The Everest party wears layers of silk, wool and a windproof gabardine smock.
Nordic walkers take a wool base, a mid layer and a waxed shell as one fixed kit.
Gorpcore takes the trail layers into the city and shows each layer in a different colour.
